purpose: Context KB for camt.057.001.06 Notification To Receive V06 validation (CBPR+ SR2026). For each XML tag: possible errors, affected tags, and fix suggestions, plus ISO 20022 / CBPR+ formal rules.

iso_20022_rules.NTFCTN_ITM_MANDATORY: Each Ntfctn must contain at least one Itm [1..n].
iso_20022_rules.ITM_AMT_MANDATORY: Each Itm must carry an Amt (ActiveOrHistoricCurrencyAndAmount) [1..1].
iso_20022_rules.ITM_ID_MANDATORY: Each Itm must have an Id (Max35Text) [1..1].
iso_20022_rules.GRPHDR_MANDATORY: GrpHdr with MsgId and CreDtTm is mandatory [1..1].
iso_20022_rules.XPCTDVALDT_NOT_PAST: XpctdValDt (expected value date) must not be in the past.
iso_20022_rules.UETR_RECOMMENDED: Itm.UETR (UUIDv4) is strongly recommended under CBPR+ to correlate the notification with the originating payment.
iso_20022_rules.DuplicateIdentifierValue: [DUPLICATE_ID_VALUE] Identifiers required to be unique within a message (e.g. InstrId, TxId, EndToEndId, UETR) must not repeat across transactions or collide with GrpHdr/MsgId.
iso_20022_rules.BicNotInDirectory: [BIC_NOT_FOUND] Each BICFI should resolve to a registered institution in the official BIC directory.
iso_20022_rules.MissingLeiAdvisory: [MISSING_LEI_ADVISORY] Under SR2026 a Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) is highly recommended for all financial institutions.

cbpr_plus_formal_rules: AppHdr (BusinessApplicationHeaderV02) is mandatory for all CBPR+ messages and must precede the Document element.
AppHdr (BusinessApplicationHeader) is mandatory for all CBPR+ camt.057 messages.
AppHdr/BizMsgIdr must equal GrpHdr/MsgId.
AppHdr/MsgDefIdr must equal 'camt.057.001.08'.
AppHdr/BizSvc must be 'swift.cbprplus.03' for CBPR+ camt.057 messages.
AppHdr/CreDt must use format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM — 'Z' suffix is forbidden.
AppHdr/Fr and AppHdr/To are mandatory; each must contain a valid BICFI.
Itm/UETR if present must be a valid UUID v4 (lowercase hex, format xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx).
XpctdValDt must not be a past date (PAST_DATE_ERROR).
When BICFI is present inside FinInstnId, Nm and PstlAdr must NOT also be present (BICFI exclusivity).
AcctSvcr/FinInstnId/BICFI should identify the account-servicing institution.
The Business Message Identifier must match the Message Identification in the Group Header.
If used, the Related BAH must transport the exact same information as in the BAH of the related message.

The Business Message Identifier is the unique identifier of the Business Message instance that is being transported with this header, as defined by the sending application or system. Must contain the Message Identification element from the Group Header of the underlying message, where available (as is typically the case with pacs, pain, and camt messages, for example). If Message Identification is not available in the underlying message, then this element must contain the unique identifier of the Business Message instance.

The Message Definition Identifier of the Business Message instance that is being transported with this header. In general, it must be formatted exactly as it appears in the namespace of the Business Message instance.
If related BAH is present, it should transport the element Business Service.
If related BAH is present, then it is recommended to transport the element Business Service.
If Postal Address is present then Name is mandatory.
If AnyBIC is absent then Name is mandatory and it is recommended to also provide the Postal Address.
Data present in structured elements within the Postal Address must not, under any circumstances be repeated in AddressLine.

(Clearing Code OR LEI) AND (Name AND ([Structured postal address with minimum Town Name and Country] OR [Hybrid postal address with minimum Town Name and Country]). It is recommended to also add the post code when available.
BICFI, complemented optionally with a LEI (preferred option)
Name AND ([Structured postal address with minimum Town Name and Country] OR [Hybrid postal address with minimum Town Name and Country]). It is recommended to also add the post code when available.
Name and Address must always be present together.
If Notification/ExpectedValueDate is absent, then item/ExpectedValueDate must be present.
If AnyBIC is absent, then Name is mandatory.
The codes XAU, XAG, XPD and XPT are not allowed, as these are codes are only used for commodities.
If Any BIC is present, then (Name and Postal Address) is NOT allowed (other elements remain optional) - However, in case of conflicting information, AnyBIC will always take precedence.
Whenever Debtor Agent, Creditor Agent and all agents in between are located within the same country, the clearing code only may be used.
If the transaction is exchanged on the SWIFT network (i.e. if the sender and receiver of the message are on SWIFT), then BIC is mandatory and other elements are optional, eg LEI

schema_mapping_notes.Ntfctn_vs_Ntfctn: camt.057 uses AccountNotification23 as the Ntfctn type — NOT to be confused with camt.054 which uses BankToCustomerDebitCreditNotificationV10.
schema_mapping_notes.Party50Choice: AcctOwnr and Dbtr at both Ntfctn and Itm level use Party50Choice — either a Pty (PartyIdentification272) or an Agt (BranchAndFinancialInstitutionIdentification8). Prefer Agt/FinInstnId/BICFI for FI parties.
schema_mapping_notes.UETR_optional_but_recommended: XSD marks Itm/UETR as [0..1] but SWIFT CBPR+ strongly recommends including it to allow correlation with the originating pacs.008/pacs.009 transaction.
schema_mapping_notes.Amt_attribute: Itm/Amt is ActiveOrHistoricCurrencyAndAmount — it requires a @Ccy attribute. Omitting the attribute causes an XSD schema validation failure.
schema_mapping_notes.root_element: camt.057.001.08 root is /Document/NtfctnToRcv (NotificationToReceive); the AppHdr (BAH) precedes the Document.
schema_mapping_notes.biz_svc: AppHdr/BizSvc for CBPR+ camt.057 is 'swift.cbprplus.03' (NOT 'swift.cbprplus.02'); rule CBPR_R8 enforces this.
schema_mapping_notes.datetime_format: ISODateTime fields (AppHdr/CreDt, GrpHdr/CreDtTm) use YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM; no 'Z' suffix, no milliseconds.
